items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...John Lindsay's, Joe Lindsay. [SPEAKER_04] Joe was the one that's living.

ctx.x: Well, there is supposed to be such a record that was made. Now, I know Roy can play it because he has played it for me. Lee Collins played it too on the trumpet. Yeah, well, it would be much easier on the trumpet, but on the trombone, that is something. Roy has played that This is Pretty. And there was a record, I remember at the time that it was made, maybe it didn't even come out or something, but I remember the...
You were talking about John Lindsay when he played bass?
Yeah, well you see, when he went to the Army he was a bass player.
